learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to know and explain the fundamentals of the structure, functioning, and operation of reciprocating engines.
Students are able to determine the essential process parameters of reciprocating engines and hydraulic piping systems in experiments.
Students are able to independently conduct, interpret, and document the corresponding experimental investigations.

syllabus_topics: Experimental determination of influences on energy conversion in reciprocating engines
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded based on a graded report.
